critical_findings.title: Handlebars.js – Multiple JavaScript Injection Vulnerabilities
critical_findings.exploit_scenario: If handlebars is used to render user-controlled templates in portal or admin panels, attacker can execute arbitrary JavaScript via template injection
critical_findings.cross_reference: [CROSS-REF: red-teamer] if template rendering is ever added to portal

critical_findings.title: protobufjs – Prototype Pollution & Regex DoS
critical_findings.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends crafted OpenTelemetry trace messages with prototype pollution payload → memory/state corruption

critical_findings.title: vitest – Critical Breaking Changes & Version Mismatch
critical_findings.exploit_scenario: Test snapshot corruption, test isolation failures, different assertion behavior across modules → inconsistent CI/CD behavior

high_risk_findings.title: form-data – CRLF Injection via Multipart Headers
high_risk_findings.exploit_scenario: User uploads file with CRLF in filename → HTTP header injection → cache poisoning or request smuggling

high_risk_findings.title: @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node – Prometheus Exporter Crash
high_risk_findings.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends malformed HTTP request to /metrics endpoint → Prometheus exporter crashes → process exits with no observability
high_risk_findings.impact: Portal backend loses monitoring; inspector.config.yml shows metrics critical for health checks

high_risk_findings.title: vite – Security: Environment Variable Leak via Source Map
high_risk_findings.exploit_scenario: Source maps in built artifacts leak .env values to browser developers → API keys, secrets exposed

high_risk_findings.title: react-router-dom – Open Redirect via Protocol-Relative URLs
high_risk_findings.status: AT RISK BOUNDARY (already on 6.30.3, fix available as 6.30.4)
high_risk_findings.exploit_scenario: User clicks link with path //attacker.com → bypasses same-origin checks → open redirect

high_risk_findings.title: @opentelemetry/sdk-node – W3C Baggage Unbounded Memory Allocation
high_risk_findings.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends X-W3C-Baggage header with 10MB payload → process OOM → crash

outdated_major_versions.notes: Still maintained; upgrade has breaking changes in 9.x and 10.x. Review changelogs before upgrading.
Also has buffer overflow fix in 11.1.1 — minimum upgrade to 11.1.1
